name: splice-equivalence
body: The correctness law of the incremental database build: the win-C spliced `db.lbug` must be a full rebuild's projection of the assembled graph for EVERY table — code and authored/transient alike — not only the code tables its DML writes. Core domain concept of this change-set; its aggregate root is the incremental splice. Supporting concepts: the seed-equivalence guard, the durable layer node set, the shared fact store vs the local seed, the content identity, the freshness fast path, and the merge rebuild.
